messages:
Alex: quick thread — planning to enable feature_flag:llm_v2_routing at 5% as part of the 02:00 PT deploy tomorrow. want to confirm preflight and rollback playbook.
Maya: window ok for me, 02:00 PT quiet window. what's the canary cohort?
Alex: canary = 1% internal + 4% external split across eu-west/us-west. we'll pin model version v2.1 to the canary route.
Jamal: ops checklist: pin db migration? any schema touches?
Alex: no schema changes. it's purely routing and model variant pinning. rollout steps: 1) deploy routing code, 2) enable ff at 1% internal, wait 15m health gates, 3) expand to 5% external if ok.
Priya: add health gates: 99th p50 latency bump > 15% AND error rate > 1% triggers hold and rollback. also monitor cost per token delta.
Maya: agree. add auto-fallback policy: if capacity issues in us-west, route to v2.0. is that configured?
Alex: yes, routing config has fallback_to: v2.0. canary will be pinned to shard-12 to limit blast radius.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by Alex at 2026-03-22T02:00:00-07:00. job id: deploy-17589. notify: @sre-oncall.
sre-oncall: acknowledged. I'll be on pager-watch during the window. escalation: if rollback required, page infra-lead and product-lead.
Jamal: rollback steps documented? put explicit commands in the thread so oncall can run without digging.
Priya: good call — adding quick runbook snippet:

```
# To fast-disable flag
curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_API_TOKEN\" \\
  https://controlplane.redwood/api/flags/llm_v2_routing/disable 

# To pin traffic back to v2.0
curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_API_TOKEN\" \\
  -d '{\"route\":\"inference-api\",\"model_version\":\"v2.0\",\"pin\":true}' \\
  https://controlplane.redwood/api/route/pin
```

Alex: also add deploybot quick rollback alias: `deploy-bot rollback deploy-17589 --fast` — that will drain new shards and restore previous routing.
Maya: telemetry to watch: request_errors, generation_timeout, cost_per_token, user_latency_percentiles, tail-qps. set alarms at 3x baseline for request_errors and 1.25x for p99 latency.
Priya: I'll push a dashboard link in the release notes: https://console.redwood/dashboards/llm_v2_canary
Alex: release notes draft:
- feature: gradual rollout of llm_v2 routing (v2.1)
- default fallback: v2.0
- canary cohorts: 1% internal, 4% external
- health gates: latency p99 +15% or errors +1% -> hold/rollback
- rollback command snippets included
Link: https://confluence.redwood/releases/llm-v2-routing-17589
Jamal: who will execute the hold/rollback? oncall or eng-releases lead?
sre-oncall: primary oncall will execute fast-disable + page eng-releases lead. if oncall is uncertain, call pager and we'll escalate.
Maya: post-deploy checks: run golden prompt smoke tests against v2.1 cohort and compare BLEU-esque metrics + hallucination checks. set a 10-minute window for initial verification.
Alex: can we add a short circuit in the API to reject requests over X tokens for canary to limit cost?
Priya: yes — will add `max_tokens: 512` override for canary traffic.
deploy-bot: reminder 30m before deploy: deploy-17589 will start in 30 minutes.
Alex: final ask — if any of us sees >0.5% increase in user-facing errors, start the rollback immediately. no long debate.
Maya: noted. I'll be watching logs and smoke tests.
Jamal: I'll keep an eye on infra metrics and GPU memory pressure on shard-12.
Priya: publishing final release note and dashboard links now.
Alex: thanks team. I'll run the deploy and monitor. ping here when you see anything odd. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy-17589 started at 2026-03-22T02:00:00-07:00 — canary stage: internal 1% applied.
Maya: internal smoke tests green at +2m.
sre-oncall: metrics look stable so far. p99 +3%, errors steady.
Priya: external cohort at 4% applied.
Jamal: observing slight qps bump on shard-12, memory OK.
Maya: golden prompt comparison looks fine. no hallucination regressions in initial set.
Alex: holding 15m window, will check again at +15.
Maya: +15m checks good. expanding rollout to 10% as intermediate step?
Alex: prefer to keep to plan (5%) for tonight — we can iterate tomorrow.
Priya: received alert: cost_per_token increased by 18% for canary. within expected but flagging.
Alex: that's acceptable given quality delta. continue.
deploy-bot: deploy-17589 completed: rollout at 5% external applied.
Maya: marking release notes as live.
Jamal: leaving one action: schedule follow-up to evaluate unit economics after 48h.
Alex: added action: postmortem if any rollback within 24h. otherwise record metrics in weekly inference review.
Priya: closing loop — dashboard and runbook links in confluence updated.
Alex: thanks all. thread closed unless urgent followups.
